title: Russian_Spacewalk_62_Animation
description: This animation discusses the upcoming spacewalk in which Roscosmos cosmonauts Oleg Kononenko and Nikolai Chub of the Expedition 71 crew will egress the Poisk airlock to complete the deployment of one panel on a synthetic radar system on the Nauka module and install equipment and experiments on the Poisk module to analyze the level of corrosion on station surfaces and modules. It will be the 270th spacewalk in support of station maintenance and upgrades, the seventh for Kononenko and the second for Chub.
keywords: RS 62, Russian EVA, Russian Spacewalk, Expedition 71
via: the NASA Image and Video Library

transcript.text: Russian spacewalk 62 will be conducted by Oleg Kononenko, EV1 in the red stripes and
Nikolaj Chub, EV2 in the blue stripes.
To start the spacewalk, Crew will egress Poisk with a Platform and temp stow it immediately
for later installment during the spacewalk.
This Platform is an adapter and attachment point for more Russian hardware to be installed
on this spacewalk.
After stowing the hardware, Oleg and Nikolaj will turn on the helmet video and lights,
then begin translation on Strela1, a telescopic pole that can be used as a crane to move crew
and equipment around.
Once the RS crew arrive at the Nauka module, they will continue nadir until they reach
the first worksite to fully deploy the MiniRSA Panel, also known as the Mini Radar with Synthetic
Aperture.
Oleg and Nikolaj will then work together to swab the exterior of Nauka to take samples
for an on-going test.Both crew will take the same translation back to Poisk where EV1 will
divert from EV2 and first begin the removal of a boom and then second a BIORISK-MSN cannister.
The cannister will later be returned to the A/L as part of a Russian science experiment.
While Oleg does his removal Tasks at Poisk, Nikolaj translates the Portable Mulitpurpose
Workstation on Zvezda plane 2 to remove and relocate an adapter.
Both crew will translate back the Airlock Hatch Location on Poisk where EV1 will stow
the boom for later jettison and meet with EV2 at the Platform stowed earlier in the
spacewalk.
Oleg and Nikolaj will translate with the platform and adapter to the opposite, fwd side of Poisk
to first install the platform and then Nikolaj's adapter on top.
Both crew will translate aft again on Poisk to change the orientation of the BKDO, another
Russian Science Experiment, and then continue aft to the air lock.
When EV1 and EV2 arrive at the Airlock Hatch, Oleg will stow the Biorisk Cannister.
Both crew will then each retrieve multiple pieces of hardware to install on the Platform
as their next task.
Both crew will, again, translate to the forward side of Poisk to install their hardware on
the Platform.
First Nikolaj will attach and configure the Kvartz Unit on top of the adapter and then
Oleg will install and configure the TKK Unit on his side of the Platform.
Once complete with the hardware installation.
Crew will begin the final portion of this task and route the cables as they translate
aft on Poisk towards the Hatch.
They'll perform a tool inventory, inspect each other's suit, ingress, and close the
hatch, thus ending Russian spacewalk 62.
